description: Return a random quote from the corpus, optionally filtered by author, fame, verification status, or tag. Each result includes citation: work, year, speaker (for plays/fiction), and source URL.

author_id.description: Optional author id (e.g., "oscar-wilde", "william-shakespeare", "mark-twain"). Use list_authors to discover ids.

famous_only.description: If true, only return famous/canonical quotes.

name: random_quote

error.description: Error message when no quotes match filters

oneOf.description: Random quote with full citation details

title: Random Quote
